output.reason: The storage version moves from v1beta1 in v0.37.8 [ev-760ae3491f13] to v1 in v1.0.0 [ev-09bbe26d2f4a]. The change text says every existing NodePool object stays stored as v1beta1 until it is rewritten. A validator confirmed that karpenter.sh/v1 NodePool is served in both releases, so manifests written as v1 on a release before 1.0.0 are still stored as v1beta1. Requiring gvk-in-use at version v1beta1 is therefore too narrow: any NodePool use on an upgrade from a release before 1.0.0 is exposed.

correction.statement: The storage version of nodepools.karpenter.sh changes from v1beta1 to v1. Environments that upgrade from a release before 1.0.0 and have NodePool objects, whatever API version their manifests use, keep those objects stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them and status.storedVersions is updated.
